title: Schedule Repair
prompt:
Audit the supplied schedule for sessions J-Q and repair it with the minimum number of changed session assignments. A session assignment is its (slot, room) pair; changing slot, room, or both for one session costs one change.

Governing rules:
R1: Every session J-Q appears exactly once and every (slot, room) position contains exactly one session.
R2: Availability: J in {1,2}; K in {1,2,3}; L in {2,3}; M in {1,2,3,4}; N in {1,2,3,4}; O in {2,3,4}; P in {3,4}; Q in {3,4}.
R3: K must use R1.
R4: O must use R2.
R5: J occurs before N.
R6: L occurs before Q.
R7: K and L do not share a slot.
R8: M and O do not share a slot.
R9: N and P do not share a slot.

Supplied schedule:
slot 1: R1=J, R2=M
slot 2: R1=Q, R2=O
slot 3: R1=L, R2=K
slot 4: R1=N, R2=P

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"violations":["R2","R3"],"schedule":[{"session":"J","slot":1,"room":"R1"}, ...]}}
Report the complete set of violated rule IDs in the supplied schedule and a complete repaired schedule. Any valid minimum-change repair is accepted.
